description: Agentic academic paper reviewer modeled on paperreview.ai (by Yixing Jiang and Andrew Ng; independent, not affiliated). Produces a grounded, ICLR-style referee report for a research paper (local PDF, arXiv ID or URL, or LaTeX/Markdown source): retrieves related work from arXiv, critiques it with per-claim grounding, scores 7 dimensions and combines them into a 1-10 overall score. Use when the user asks to review a paper, referee or assess a manuscript, get feedback on a draft before submission, check novelty against prior work, or estimate a paper's acceptance chances.
